invalid_request: The request is invalid. Check the values you entered and try again.
bad_request_body: The model rejected the request body as malformed. Check the request parameters.
model_name_required: The request does not name a model. Fill in the model parameter.
request_body_too_large: The request is too large. Shorten it or split it into smaller requests.
context_length_exceeded: The input is longer than this model's context window. Shorten the conversation or choose a model with a longer context.
protocol_bridge_unsupported: This route cannot pass a feature of the request to the selected model. Choose a model that supports it natively.
capability_unsupported: The selected model does not support a feature this request uses. Choose a model that supports it.
convert_request_failed: The request could not be converted for the selected model. Check the parameters or choose another model.
missing_required_parameter: A required parameter is missing. Check the endpoint reference and add it.
endpoint_not_supported: This endpoint is not supported. Check the request URL.
tokenization_error: The input tokens could not be counted. Check that the input is complete.
resource_not_found: This item was not found. It may have been deleted; refresh and try again.
version_conflict: This record changed after you opened it. Refresh and make your change again.
state_conflict: This action does not apply in the current state. Refresh to see the latest state.
invalid_api_key: The API key is invalid. Check that it was copied in full, or create a new key in the console.
token_expired: This API key has expired. Extend its expiry in the console or create a new key.
token_disabled: This API key is disabled. Enable it in the console or use another key.
ephemeral_credential_denied: This temporary credential cannot be used for this request. Use it only with the models and endpoints it was issued for.
proxy_signature_invalid: The request origin could not be verified. Try again later; contact support if this continues.
session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
session_invalid: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
session_user_mismatch: This page belongs to a different signed-in account. Reload the page.
access_token_invalid: The access token is invalid. Generate a new access token in your settings.
access_denied: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an administrator for access.
ip_not_allowed: This API key does not accept requests from your current IP address. Check the key's IP restrictions.
user_banned: This account has been disabled. Contact an administrator if you have questions.
group_access_denied: This account cannot use the requested lane. Choose another lane.
channel_selection_denied: Only administrators can pin a request to a specific channel.
project_access_suspended: Your access to this project is suspended. Contact a project admin.
address_not_enabled: This API address is not enabled for your account. Switch back to the default API address.
insufficient_quota: Your wallet balance is too low for this request. Top up to continue.
key_budget_exceeded: This API key's budget cannot cover the request, so it was not sent. Raise the key budget or lower the output limit.
pre_consume_token_quota_failed: This API key's remaining allowance cannot cover the request. Raise the allowance or use another key.
member_budget_exceeded: Your monthly member budget is used up. Ask a project admin to adjust it.
project_budget_exceeded: The project budget is used up. Ask a project admin to adjust it.
platform_budget_exceeded: The platform spending limit has been reached. Contact the platform administrator.
pricing_not_configured: This model has no price on the selected lane yet, so it can't be used. Choose another model.
model_not_found: This model is not in the model catalog. Check the model name.
model_not_allowed: This API key is not allowed to use the requested model. Check the key's model scope.
token_vendor_denied: This API key is not allowed to use models from this vendor. Check the key's vendor scope.
no_available_channel: No route can serve this model right now. Try again later or choose another model.
invalid_channel_id: The requested channel ID is invalid.
channel_config_invalid: This model is temporarily unavailable and the request was not completed. Try again later.
channel_no_available_key: This model is temporarily unavailable and the request was not completed. Try again later.
preferred_lane_unavailable: This model is not available on the lane this API key is pinned to, and automatic fallback is off. Choose another model or change the key's lane.
prompt_blocked: The model refused this content under its content policy. Revise the content and try again.
token_rate_limit_exceeded: This API key is sending requests too quickly. Wait for the Retry-After interval and try again.
request_rate_limit_exceeded: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
total_request_rate_limit_exceeded: The total request limit has been reached. Wait a moment and try again.
gateway_overloaded: The gateway is busy right now. Try again shortly.
upstream_rate_limited: This model is limiting requests right now. Try again shortly.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
upstream_error: The model returned an error. Try again later.
upstream_invalid_response: The model's response could not be used. Check whether a result was produced before you retry.
upstream_stream_failed: The model stopped with an error while streaming. Check the partial output before you retry.
upstream_timeout: The model did not respond in time, so the outcome is unconfirmed. Check your usage log before resending.
upstream_network_error: The connection to the model failed. Try again shortly.
upstream_overloaded: The model is busy right now. Try again shortly.
upstream_auth_failed: This model is temporarily unavailable and the request was not completed. Try again later.
upstream_billing_failed: This model is temporarily unavailable and the request was not completed. Try again later.
internal_error: The service could not complete this request. If it keeps happening, contact support with the request ID.
not_implemented: This feature is not available yet.

type.invalid_request_error: The request is invalid. Check it and try again.
type.authentication_error: Authentication failed. Sign in again or check your API key.
type.permission_error: You don't have permission to do this.
type.not_found_error: This item was not found. Refresh and try again.
type.rate_limit_error: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
type.api_error: The service could not complete this request. Try again later.
type.overloaded_error: The service is busy right now. Try again shortly.
type.api_connection_error: The connection dropped, so the outcome is unconfirmed. Check the current state before you retry.
type.timeout_error: The request timed out, so the outcome is unconfirmed. Check the current state before you retry.
type.content_policy_violation_error: The content was refused under the model's content policy. Revise it and try again.
type.insufficient_quota: Your balance or budget is too low. Check your wallet and budgets.
type.conflict_error: The data changed in the meantime. Refresh and make your change again.

local.incomplete_page: The list changed while loading and could not be fully loaded. Refresh and try again.
local.network: No response from the server, so the outcome is unconfirmed. Check your network, then refresh to confirm.
local.timeout: The request timed out, so the outcome is unconfirmed. Refresh to confirm before you retry.
local.unknown: The action did not complete. Try again later.
local.loadFailed: This part could not be loaded.
